name: Ravening
source:
In 1987, a buried, maze-like estate was discovered in the ██████ mountains. Thought to belong to a forgotten duke, it contained hundreds of identical halls, sealed passages, and a single hidden exit. Records suggest the duke spent his fortune building the labyrinth before burning the village below, where he likely perished. How the site was buried remains unknown.

Only one artifact was found: a damaged diary from the village tavern. Its contents are presented here, unedited.

[From [url=https://runa-liore.itch.io/ravening]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1987年，在 ██████ 山脉中发现了一座地下迷宫般的庄园。它被认为属于一位被遗忘的公爵，里面有数百个相同的大厅、密封的通道和一个隐藏的出口。记录显示，公爵花了大量的钱建造了迷宫，然后烧毁了下面的村庄，他很可能就是在那里丧生的。该遗址是如何被掩埋的仍然未知。

只发现了一件文物：村里酒馆里的一本损坏的日记。其内容未经编辑就呈现在此处。

[来自[url=https://runa-liore.itch.io/ravening]Itch.io[/url]]
